Answer the customer's question using only the documentation passages provided in the message. Each passage starts with an ID in square brackets, such as [pricing-1].

Documentation passages:

[pricing-5] Changing plans
Upgrades take effect immediately, and the price difference for the rest of the billing period is charged on a prorated basis. Downgrades take effect at the next billing date; until then the workspace keeps the features of its current plan.

[data-3] Data export
CSV and JSON exports are available on every plan. Business plans can also schedule automatic exports to an Amazon S3 bucket.

[pricing-3] Free trial
Every new workspace starts with a 14-day free trial of the Team plan. No credit card is needed to start the trial. If no plan is chosen by the end of the trial, the workspace becomes read-only until a plan is chosen.

[sla-1] Uptime commitment
Business plans are covered by a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment and Team plans by a 99.5% monthly uptime commitment. Starter plans have no uptime commitment, are not covered by the service level agreement and are not eligible for service credits after an outage.

Customer question: When does a downgrade to a cheaper plan take effect?

data.answer: A downgrade to a cheaper plan takes effect at the next billing date. Until then, the workspace keeps the features of its current plan.
